payload.title: Dogfood: convert this repo's own queue to the git-native backend
payload.body: Per VISION G8, the canonical repo must run on the git-native backend it recommends for collaborative repos — proving the migration, conformance, and conflict-free claiming on the project that defines them, with no awkward file-backend-only remains. Use the `consumer-migration-command` to convert this repo (dogfooding the command on its own repo): `tasks migrate --apply` imports the current `TASKS.md` into the `tasks-claims` log preserving ids/priority/tags/details, then `tasks fleet init` writes `.tasksmd.json {backend: git-native}`, `lefthook.yml`, and the projection + claim-check workflows. Then remove file-backend-only assumptions: update `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` so the task-queue policy is the git-native flow — agents claim via `tasks claim <id>` (collision-free; returns a `claimId` fencing token), complete via `tasks complete <id>`, and **never hand-edit `TASKS.md`** (it is now a single-writer generated snapshot regenerated by the projection job). Keep the file backend intact across the product (spec, examples, packages) — dogfooding raises the repo's own backend, it does not retire the file path. Verify the generated `TASKS.md` projection lints clean and the docs-backend-drift guard still passes.
